name: Nanami
source:
Favourite manga: Nanda no Ryu
Favourite videogame: Pika Pika Rocket
Favourite food: Chanpuruu

Nanami lives alone with her big brother Toshio after their parents disappeared.
She's a quiet introvert girl at first glance, but once she's with her friends, she's a cute energy bomb. She has a natural talent for videogames, which made of her the champion of the Osaka prefecture in numerous videogames.

[Edited from [url=http://kwk.maxlefou.com]official site[/url]]
